Verify: Hotspot click opens the action menu unit tests

tests.id: appFlow.test.tsx > App flow: action menu > Bookshelf hotspot opens action menu
tests.name: opens the Bookshelf menu on hotspot click
tests.title: App flow: action menu — clicking the Bookshelf hotspot opens its action menu with Inspect, Push, Search and Leave
tests.scenario: Given the playing view with a mocked in-memory storage, when the Bookshelf hotspot is clicked, then a region named Bookshelf with data-object-id='bookshelf' contains the Inspect, Push, Search and Leave buttons, and it was not shown before the click
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/appFlow.test.tsx -t 'action menu' --testTimeout=10000

units.title: Verify: Action and choice update the story unit tests

tests.name: App flow: story actions and choices > Search adds the hidden door text to the story history
tests.title: Search adds the hidden door text to the story history
tests.scenario: Given the playing view, when Bookshelf is clicked and then Search, then the Story history list contains 'A hidden door swings open behind the books.'
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/appFlow.test.tsx -t 'story' --testTimeout=20000
tests.detail: Storage mocked in memory via vi.mock of runtime/storage.

tests.name: App flow: story actions and choices > choosing a dialogue option closes the dialogue and records it
tests.title: choosing a dialogue option closes the dialogue and records it
tests.scenario: Given the opening dialogue, when 'Look around the room' is chosen, then the Dialogue region is gone and the Story history list contains 'Look around the room'.
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/appFlow.test.tsx -t 'story' --testTimeout=20000
tests.detail: Storage mocked in memory via vi.mock of runtime/storage.

units.title: Verify: Remount restores saved state unit tests

tests.name: App remount and saved state > Given a played game is unmounted, when the App remounts and Begin is clicked, then history, the opened hotspot and the Inventory region are restored
tests.title: Remount restores saved state: history, opened Bookshelf hotspot and Inventory region
tests.scenario: Given a played game is unmounted, when the App remounts and Begin is clicked, then history, the opened hotspot and the Inventory region are restored
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/app.test.tsx -t 'remount' --testTimeout=10000
tests.detail: Passes. Story history contains 'A hidden door swings open behind the books.', Bookshelf has data-open='true', and region 'Inventory' is present after remount.

tests.name: App remount and saved state > Given no saved state, when Begin is clicked, then the game starts fresh at the opening dialogue with the hotspot closed
tests.title: Null saved state starts fresh at the opening dialogue with Bookshelf closed
tests.scenario: Given no saved state (getItem returns null), when Begin is clicked, then the Dialogue region shows the opening line and Bookshelf data-open is 'false'
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/app.test.tsx -t 'remount|fresh' --testTimeout=10000
tests.detail: Passes. Dialogue region contains "I don't know what to do next. What should we do?" and Bookshelf data-open='false'.
